title: The catalog answer, the locked attribute, the set rows and five message texts are not fixed by any source
source: TSD P6 Communications v2 T3.1 and appendix T-A; FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.7; legacy RWB-E2-017 sections 11 and 14
description: This story serves the template and merge field catalog that the two generation screens read: the version in force with its Legal approval and valid-from date, and the merge fields of that version with the attribute that marks a locked value. Four values the story needs are absent. (1) API-P6-005 is documented as answering the binary template body only, so the JSON catalog answer the review screen joins a merged value to is a design decision, and the query of API-P6-003 is documented without the treatment-type and product-group filters the set read needs. (2) The locked attribute of a merge field has no column in TSD P6 T3.1, which lists merge_field as DF-REF-252 to DF-REF-260. (3) The reference rows that map a treatment type and a product group to document types and template codes are named as reference data in the legacy precondition, and their shape is in no source read. (4) The text of MSG-P4-003, MSG-P5-010, MSG-P6-003 and the 403 wording reused for the two reads is not in the sources read, so those rows carry the placeholder. One combined row is raised for the story; each default is an assumption in the same Work Package.
evidence: TSD P6 v2 T-A.2 API-P6-003 documents Query code, language, state, page and size only, and API-P6-005 documents Response Binary; TSD P6 v2 T3.1 merge_field ends at DF-REF-260 with no locked or overridable column; legacy RWB-E2-017 section 3 says the set per treatment type is in reference data (assumed, DL28); legacy section 14 carries MSG-P5-002, MSG-P5-011 to MSG-P5-014, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-GEN-004, MSG-GEN-006, MSG-P7-003 and MSG-P4-002 only
proposed: Add the treatment-type and product-group filters to API-P6-003 and an application/json representation of API-P6-005 as additive changes within major version 1; add the locked attribute to merge_field in RWB-P6-E1046-CON; publish the set rows as rwb-case reference data under RWB-P3-E1043-CON; copy the five message texts from the message catalog when it is issued
